Stop VMs.

```text
pomme stop [NAMES ...] [--all] [--force] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAMES` | VM names. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--all` | Stop every running or paused VM. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Skip graceful guest shutdown. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
